Title: Craft CMS: Authenticated "assets/preview-thumb" discloses signed fallback transform preview link to CP users without asset-view permission
Description: A user with Control Panel access but without permission to view a target private asset can call `assets/preview-thumb` and receive preview HTML that contains a signed fallback transform link for that private asset.
AffectedVersions: All versions starting from 4.0.0-RC1 before 4.17.8, all versions starting from 5.0.0-RC1 before 5.9.14
NotImpacted: All versions before 4.0.0-RC1, all versions starting from 4.17.8 before 5.0.0-RC1, all versions starting from 5.9.14
